Mesh Msg

group SENSOR_MESH_MSG

Mesh message types used by sensor models.

Defines

SENSOR_PROPERTY_ID_INVALID 0

Invalid sensor property ID.

SENSOR_SETTING_PROPERTY_ID_INVALID 0

Invalid sensor setting property ID.

SENSOR_MEASUREMENT_PERIOD_NOT_APPLICABLE 0

Not applicable measurement period.

IS_SENSOR_PROPERTY_ID_VALID(id) ((id) != SENSOR_PROPERTY_ID_INVALID)

Macro to validate sensor property ID.

IS_SENSOR_SETTING_PROPERTY_ID_VALID(id) ((id) != SENSOR_SETTING_PROPERTY_ID_INVALID)

Macro to validate sensor setting property ID.

IS_FAST_CADENCE_DIVISIOR_VALID(divisor) ((divisor) <= 15)

Macro to validate fast cadence divisor.

IS_STATUS_MIN_INTERVAL_VALID(interval) ((interval) <= 26)

Macro to validate status minimum interval.

typedef uint8_t sensor_setting_access_t

Type alias matching _sensor_setting_access_t to ensure the correct frame format.

enum sensor_sampling_function_t

Enumeration for sensor sampling functions.

Values:

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_UNSPECIFIED

Unspecified sampling function.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_INSTANTANEOUS

Instantaneous sampling.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_ARITHMETIC_MEAN

Arithmetic mean sampling.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_RMS

Root mean square sampling.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_MAXIMUM

Maximum value sampling.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_MINIMUM

Minimum value sampling.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_ACCUMULATED

Accumulated sampling.

enumerator SENSOR_SAMPLING_COUNT

Sampling count.

enum _sensor_setting_access_t

Enumeration for sensor setting access types. Use sensor_setting_access_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator SENSOR_SETTING_ACCESS_READ_ONLY

Read-only access to sensor settings.

enumerator SENSOR_SETTING_ACCESS_READ_WRITE

Read-write access to sensor settings.

enum sensor_trigger_type_t

Enumeration for sensor trigger types.

Values:

enumerator SENSOR_TRIGGER_TYPE_CHARACTERISTIC

Trigger value format is the same as the characteristic that the sensor property ID references.

enumerator SENSOR_TRIGGER_TYPE_UNITLESS

Trigger value is unitless; format type is uint16_t, representing percentage change with 0.01 resolution.
